title: Executive Functionning Study for Assessing the Effect of Neurofeedback
description: EEG recordings from an executive functioning battery comprising the N-Back, Sustained Attention to Response Task (SART), and Local-Global tasks. Data were collected from 24 participants in two sessions, on the first and last day of a frontal midline theta neurofeedback meditation training experiment, to assess neurofeedback effects on executive function. Data are provided in EEGLAB .set format, with the original .bdf files in the sourcedata folder.
methods_description: Participants completed a visual n-back task (1- to 3-back), a SART (digits 0-9, withholding a response to 3), and a local-global letter categorization task. EEG was recorded at 2048 Hz, then down-sampled to 256 Hz, average referenced, and high-pass filtered at 1 Hz with an elliptical filter in Matlab and EEGLAB.
